summary: The daemon's Workspace CI read for st slo no longer takes a flaky fleet.yml run listing for the truth: GitHub's created= filter now and then answers empty or short while runs exist, so an empty listing whose same filter's newest run falls inside the window, or a listing shorter than its own total_count, now fails the read, which keeps the last runs until the objectives' windows age them out

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; Workspace CI runs are read from GitHub and kept in memory only.

compatibility.detail: No API, CLI or wire change. One extra list-runs read (per_page=1) only when a filtered listing comes back empty; GithubListing gains total_count.

downtime.detail: Takes effect with the next daemon build; no restart beyond the normal deploy.
